| Feature | Open System | Closed System |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mass Transfer** | Mass **can** cross the system boundary. | Mass **cannot** cross the system boundary (mass remains constant). |
| **Energy Transfer** | Both heat and work can cross the boundary. | Energy (heat/work) can cross the boundary, but no mass does. |
| **Example** | A turbine, compressor, or boiler. | A sealed piston-cylinder assembly without mass leakage. |
proTip: Always check for mass transfer across the boundary to distinguish between open and closed systems.
